source_note: Original AI-assisted community practice path spanning entry, mid, and senior individual-contributor tasks. Each pinned round is a separate practice attempt, not a hiring sequence. Practitioner review and scoring calibration are pending; these exercises do not certify professional or operational competence.
name: Architecture Practice
blurb: Practice drawing coordination, a constrained community brief, and a late design-change decision.

rounds.title: Architectural Assistant: Find a Drawing Revision Conflict
rounds.focus: Detect a cross-document mismatch and route a precise coordination issue without guessing the correct drawing.

rounds.title: Architectural Designer: Reconcile a Community Room Brief
rounds.focus: Turn an overfull brief into two transparent concept options while preserving access and functional relationships.

rounds.title: Senior Architect: Evaluate a Late Brief Change
rounds.focus: Challenge an incomplete cost-neutral claim and structure a client decision around a changed requirement.
